triggers.name: new_search_mention
triggers.title: New search mention
triggers.help: This trigger uses X's search service. Please note that X's search service and, by extension, the Search API is not meant to be an exhaustive source of Tweets. Not all Tweets will be indexed or made available via the search interface.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: query
input.label: Query
input.hint: Query for matching Tweets, with a maximum of up to 512 characters.

actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own X action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your X connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: search_tweets
actions.title: Search tweets
actions.help: This action uses X's search service. Please note that X's search service and, by extension, the Search API is not meant to be an exhaustive source of Tweets. Not all Tweets will be indexed or made available via the search interface.

input.name: query
input.label: Query
input.hint: Query for matching Tweets, with a maximum of up to 512 characters.

input.name: usernames
input.label: User names
input.hint: The username (handle) of the user. To search for multiple users, provide a comma separated list of usernames (upto a maximum of 100).
